model_annotations.English: The pie chart represents the distribution of articles across different years, divided into three categories. The percentage labels are shown inside each slice, along with a numerical value in parentheses. The chart does not include a legend, and none of the slices are visually emphasized. The slices appear to be arranged in descending order of their proportions.
